headline: Google is replacing Gemini Gems, the custom assistants in its Gemini app, with a new feature called Skills, and will convert existing Gems on a staged schedule.
score_reason: Account-by-account migration guide for an announcement made on 30 Sep, so before the window; it is an organisational change, not a smarter model; score lowered by 1.
importance_line: People who built Gems keep their instructions but should check them, with personal accounts converting from November 2026 and Workspace accounts no earlier than March 2027, and sharing and attachments may not carry over.
summary: Online Tech Tips reports that Google announced on 30 Sep 2026 that Gemini Gems will be replaced by Skills, reusable instructions that work inside any regular Gemini chat, and that Google will recreate existing Gems as Skills. Personal accounts convert from November 2026, Workspace business accounts no earlier than 1 Mar 2027 and education accounts no earlier than 1 Jun 2027, and attached files and sharing settings may not transfer; the site stresses that Skills are a change in organisation, not evidence of better answers.
notes: Google announced on 30 Sep 2026; this article (6 Oct) is a timeline explainer drawn from Google documents and Android Authority. Score lowered by 1 (5 to 4).
